rationale: Baseline for the loop: harness change 2f82a4c (policy-id proofreader) with the Part C prompt change reapplied (784d389).
Delete the 'explain your reasoning before every tool call' rule; in the baseline about 6 of 10 failed refund runs and e-012 ended after announcing a lookup without making it.

Tell the agent to trust refund_eligible from get_order instead of recomputing the window from dates; after candidate 1, 8 of 10 failed refund runs saw refund_eligible true and refused anyway, counting from the real calendar instead of the world's frozen date.

Stopped by the student's time cap of 2 to 3 candidates (Homework 9 due the same week), not by the two-misses rule: both candidates improved. 48 of 150 runs used. Remaining failure: e-002 asks before refunding in 4 of 5 runs, where the customer asked to return but did not say refund.
